summary: Iteration 114: KARAU Phase 3 - Guest 2FA Security + Calendar/Social Sharing. All 17 backend API tests PASSED (100%). Frontend UI verified: GuestJoinPage 3-step 2FA flow (Details→OTP→Age), ShareMeetingDialog with social buttons (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, WhatsApp, Email) and calendar exports (ICS, Google Calendar). OTP delivery is MOCKED (_dev_otp field returned for testing).

backend_api_tests: GET /api/karau-meet/guest/status - Returns verified=true for verified guest (200)
E2E Guest Flow - Complete register→verify→age→status flow
frontend_ui_tests: GuestJoinPage loads at /karau-meet/join/{meetingId} for unauthenticated users
Step indicator shows 3 steps: Details, Verify, Confirm
Step 2 (OTP): Resend OTP button with countdown (data-testid=guest-resend-otp)
Dashboard: New Meeting button opens create dialog (data-testid=btn-new-meeting)

critical_code_review_comments: Backend: Guest registration correctly stores OTP in memory and DB with 10-minute expiry
Backend: OTP verification has 5-attempt limit before requiring new code
Backend: Age declaration requires prior OTP verification (proper flow enforcement)
Backend: Guest status endpoint excludes MongoDB _id field from response
Backend: ICS calendar export includes VALARM reminder 15 minutes before meeting
Backend: Social share links properly URL-encode meeting titles and join URLs
Frontend: GuestJoinPage uses proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Frontend: OTP input supports paste handling for 6-digit codes
Frontend: ShareMeetingDialog fetches social links from backend API with client-side fallback
seed_data_creation: Multiple test guest records created during pytest with TEST_ prefix emails. Test meetings created for ICS/social sharing tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: KARAU Phase 3 Guest Security fully implemented and tested. Guest 2FA flow: Step 1 (name+email) → Step 2 (6-digit OTP with resend/cooldown) → Step 3 (age 16+ checkbox) → redirect to lobby. OTP is returned in _dev_otp field for testing (email sending is MOCKED). ShareMeetingDialog has social buttons (LinkedIn/Twitter/WhatsApp/Email) and calendar buttons (ICS download/Google Calendar). To test guest flow: go to /karau-meet/join/{meetingId} in incognito, or clear localStorage first. To test share dialog: login as admin, create meeting, click share icon on meeting card.

mocked_apis_list: Email OTP delivery (OTP returned in _dev_otp field)

social_sharing.ui_buttons: ShareMeetingDialog with 4 social buttons (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, WhatsApp, Email)
